name: Verdant Engine
purpose: Universal 3D browser and WebAssembly game engine mechanized with Prism, exact uor-matmul tensor contractions, progressive UORC streaming, glTF 2.0, portable WGSL, rigid-body physics, and spatial audio.
tagline: Prism Model-Centric Runtime — universal 3D, semiring, and cybernetic model execution powered by UOR Prism.

promise.headline: Lawful high-definition 3D worlds, 22-joint IK characters, neuromorphic attention, and Stitch multiplayer in every browser.
promise.detail: Every pass reduces to exact uor-matmul semiring contractions, LOD0..LOD4 progressive UORC synthesis, swept triangle BLAS CCD, near-sphere camera guards, floating-origin cells, and 2-of-3 Stitch parity custody.

claim: VE-10: the engine verifier answers conformant only for monotonic progressive UORC and HD streaming LODs, overflow-safe uor-matmul tensor kernels, and constructive subsystem/telos invariants, refuses zero-extent or narrow-accumulator contractions, and answers invalid request for unknown queries.

proposition.name: TensorKernelValid
proposition.text:
TensorKernelValid kernel :=
  0 < kernel.lhsCols
  /\ kernel.minAccumBits <= kernel.accumBits
  /\ 0 < kernel.minAccumBits
  /\ kernel.tileAligned = true

HdLodsMonotonic lods :=
  StrictResolutionAscent LOD0 -> LOD1 -> LOD2 -> LOD3 (lossless UORC) -> LOD4 (HD synthesis)
proposition.plain: Every Prism-hosted engine tensor kernel satisfies exact Laurent or tropical accumulator bit-width bounds and tile alignment, while UORC and HD synthesis frames stream strictly monotonically from coarse proxy through ultra-high-definition architectural fidelity.
